Activation (bus-api@v1) and the workspace scan ... call the same functions'. Spec §7.2 now also carries 'Scope timing', which bus-api@v2 G42 enforces with a StateError outside the analyses (bus-api@v2's migration note: 'not a topology-ir@v1 finding, whose family is closed'). options.consequence: Refinement 4 now reads 'the checks of Spec §3.8, §3.11 and §7.2 "Scope compatibility". Spec §7.2 "Scope timing" is not an analysis: bus-api@v2 rejects a MODULE or PAGE activation before start() itself (its G42), and the rejection is no finding of this contract.' options.label: move the citation only, report a finding

decisions.chosen: restate the bullet to match bus-api@v2
decisions.why: The bullet as a whole states which activation checks (bus-api's) the analyses implement, and the moved bus-api@v2 citation sits in it. Under bus-api@v2 G42 and Spec §7.2 'Scope timing' the first sentence became false. The orchestrator's touch rule restates such a sentence to the cited contract's current text, 'whatever version first made the sentence false', and this restatement changes no declaration, guarantee or fixture. Close call on remit: the false sentence is the bullet's first, while the moved citation is in its second. Signal that would have changed my mind: an orchestrator reading of the touch rule that confines restatement to the sentence holding the moved citation; then revert to the old first sentence and route it as a finding to a later hsdd-contract step.

The Boundary row only assigns idempotency to bus-api; the Equality paragraph says two declarations that differ only in a scan's initial value, a closure body or same-named functions project to equal definitions, which stays true and says nothing about activation; TopologyGraph's 'equal ones count once (Spec §3.9)' is a rule of this contract's graph value (G11), and Spec §3.9 is word for word the same in v0.15.1. Signal that would change it: a consumer that relies on topology-ir's equality to predict re-activation, which none of bus-api@v2, topology-dsl@v2 or this file does.
